Title:
NETMESSAGE:Current location:

Research and Teleportation outpost approximately
10 miles from the Black Mesa Research Facility.
Translation: 当前位置：\n\n研究与传送前哨站，距黑山研究基地约10英里。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The storage door is locked.\nI need to find the key...
Translation: 储物室的门锁着。\n我得找到钥匙……

Title: NETMESSAGE:Picked up the storage door key...

NETMESSAGE:So the government guy left me here, in a place where I could do no
possible harm and where no harm could come to me. Heh, this is the
least what I expected to be honest.
For the past few days I've been stuck here on a island
right in the middle of Xen.
Translation: 于是那个政府的人把我留在了这儿，一个我既伤不了人、人也伤不了我的地方。嘿，说实话，这完全出乎我的意料。\n过去的几天里，我一直被困在这个位于Xen中央的小岛上。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:I guess it could be worse though. Some of the Xen creatures seem to have
gone tame and refuse to attack anything that steps in their way while
 others have disappeared altogether. I wonder if this Freeman guy was
 responsible for this. Either way, I've had some success communicating
with another human on the radio, presumably a scientist. He said he'd
 try and locate my position...
Translation: 不过想想，情况或许还能更糟。有些Xen生物似乎已经变得温顺，不再攻击任何挡路的家伙，而其他的则完全消失了。我在想，是不是那个弗里曼搞的鬼。不管怎样，我已经成功通过无线电和另一个人类沟通了，大概是个科学家。他说他会尝试定位我的位置……
